description: Forward fuselage of a former Mexican 737-205 installed as a children's attraction inside the KidZania centre in the Akasya shopping mall at Acıbadem. Construction number 21184. spottingmode status preserved last updated 5 October 2016. This is a fuselage section rather than a complete airframe.
museum_name: Akasya KidZania 737 Nose Section -- Üsküdar, İstanbul
